// The real SDK called directly (no Tarsee code), the stream read to its very end, to see what it throws.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
const SCRATCH = process.env.VERIFY_SCRATCH;
const sdk = await import(pathToFileURL(`${process.env.TARSEE_NODE_PROJECT}/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs`).href);
const STUB = path.join(SCRATCH, "stub", "fake-claude.exe").replace(/\//g, "\\");
const base = {}; for (const k of ["PATH", "PATHEXT", "SystemRoot", "SystemDrive", "COMSPEC", "TEMP", "TMP", "windir"]) if (process.env[k]) base[k] = process.env[k];
async function go(name, scenario, extraOpts = {}, extraEnv = {}) {
  const out = path.join(SCRATCH, "out", `direct-${name}.stub.jsonl`); fs.rmSync(out, { force: true });
  const seen = []; let err = null;
  try {
    for await (const m of sdk.query({ prompt: "hi", options: { pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: STUB, cwd: path.join(SCRATCH, "ws"), env: { ...base, VSTUB_OUT: out, VSTUB_SCENARIO: scenario, ...extraEnv }, ...extraOpts } })) seen.push(m.type + (m.subtype ? "/" + m.subtype : ""));
  } catch (e) { err = `${e.name}: ${e.message}`; }
  const stub = fs.existsSync(out) ? fs.readFileSync(out, "utf8").trim().split("\n").map((l) => JSON.parse(l)) : [];
  console.log(`--- ${name}\n  seen: ${seen.join(" ")}\n  thrown: ${err}\n  argv: ${JSON.stringify(stub[0]?.argv)}`);
  return stub;
}
await go("error-result", "error-result");
await go("api-error-result", "api-error-result");
await go("turn-minimal-options", "turn");
process.env.DEBUG_CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK = "1";
const s = await go("debug-env", "turn", {}, { DEBUG_CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK: "1", DEBUG: "canary" });
console.log("  DEBUG in child:", JSON.stringify(s[0]?.env?.DEBUG));
process.exit(0);
